sections.description: Private member dashboard, membership, workshop, lesson, payment, and OTP system.
sections.changelog:
1.3.7

  • Fixed the Dashboard Home timeout path by keeping lesson bodies, videos, content filtering, and oEmbed work out of the initial Dashboard AJAX response.
  • Course cards now use one batched lesson-count query; detailed lessons load only when an authorized user opens that course.
  • Stopped legacy Workshop records from being treated as Dashboard Course records.

1.3.6

  • Added a protected, server-rendered Administrator overview to Dashboard Home with Customer, Workshop, Course, and successful-payment counts.
  • Added desktop sidebar navigation scrolling while keeping the logo and Logout control fixed.
  • Overview Customer count reuses the same authoritative WordPress Customer source as the native and Dashboard Members screens.

1.3.5

  • Dashboard and native Members now use WordPress Customer users as the primary member population.
  • Added batched canonical Workshop-assignment display and Customer/Workshop diagnostics.

1.3.4

  • Normalized Dashboard Members fields to the shared authoritative member response.
  • Added protected member-query diagnostics and controlled debug logging for database failures.

1.3.3

  • Unified native WordPress Admin and Dashboard Members behind one authoritative member data service.
